# TV Guide & Know Your Meme

> > Comprehensive TV listings, streaming guides, and viral internet meme documentation covering TikTok trends, entertainment news, and popular culture.

This site combines TV Guide's television scheduling and streaming recommendations with Know Your Meme's documentation of viral internet culture, TikTok trends, and social media phenomena. It serves as a dual resource for both traditional entertainment discovery and understanding contemporary meme culture.

## Key Topics

- TikTok trends
- TV listings and schedules
- Netflix streaming catalog
- Viral memes and exploitables
- Live sports broadcasting
- Catchphrase memes
- Entertainment news
- Dance memes
- Image macros
- DeviantArt culture
- Breaking Bad memes
- Social media viral content
- Local broadcast schedules
- Streaming service guides

## Core TV & Streaming Resources

- [TV Guide, TV Listings, Streaming Services, Entertainment News and Celebrity News - TV Guide](https://tvguide.com): Homepage with streaming recommendations, reviews, and entertainment news
- [TV Guide, TV Listings, Online Videos, Entertainment News and Celebrity News - TV Guide](https://tvguide.com/Listings): Main TV schedule/listings page for finding shows across providers
- [Live Sports On TV Today - TV Guide](https://tvguide.com/sports/live-today): Today's live sports schedule across MLB, NBA, NHL, UEFA, and more
- [What to Watch on Netflix - TV Guide](https://tvguide.com/streaming/netflix): Netflix catalog browser with filters for movies, shows, genres, and years

## Viral Memes & TikTok Trends

- [Jesse, What the Fuck Are You Talking About | Know Your Meme](https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/jesse-what-the-fuck-are-you-talking-about): Breaking Bad dialogue meme with Walter White/Jesse Pinkman slang confusion
- [We Still Talk About You | Know Your Meme](https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/we-still-talk-about-you): Exploitable meme featuring girl/cat art from DeviantArt, viral on TikTok
- [I'm Talking About Innit | Know Your Meme](https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/im-talking-about-innit): TikTok dance trend from BunnaB/YKNiece's 'Innit' song with swimming gesture
- [What Do The Memes About Hearing Saxophones In The Hood Mean? The Viral '90s Hood... | Know Your Meme](https://trending.knowyourmeme.com/editorials/guides/what-do-the-memes-about-hearing-saxophones-in-the-hood-mean-the-viral-90s-hood-movie-trend-explained): Explains Boyz n the Hood saxophone meme trend across TikTok/Instagram Reels
- [How About A Nice Big Cup of Shut the Fuck Up | Know Your Meme](https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/how-about-a-nice-big-cup-of-shut-the-fuck-up): WWII poster-based catchphrase meme trending on TikTok with lip-dub videos
